subject.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Should this proof-positive PR be the sole landing branch for the Nostr sanitizer fix, superseding https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101760?
rationale: Both branches implement the same two-path delivery invariant, and selecting the canonical contribution is an ownership and landing choice rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Land this PR
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, rerun the focused Nostr checks, merge it, and close the parallel PR as superseded.

options.title: Land the parallel PR
options.body: First require equivalent current-head behavior proof and merge viability from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101760, then close this PR only after that alternative is safe to land.

recommendation.title: Land this PR
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, rerun the focused Nostr checks, merge it, and close the parallel PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available official repository and Nostr-package ownership signal for choosing between duplicate implementation branches.
